### AI development

Your agents take over specific workflows, each built for your exact process and connected to the
tools you already use.
* Invoice processing from vendor emails, no manual entry
* Support ticket routing and triage without a human in the loop
* Document data extraction synced to your CRM, ERP, and Slack
* Lead qualification that scores, tags, and routes enquiries in real time
* Nightly reports pulled from multiple systems and delivered to the right inbox, no manual compiling

[See how we fix this][30]

What we believe

We don't believe in "AI transformation". We quietly remove the parts of your business that nobody
enjoys doing. You get back the hours, the margin, and the focus to grow the parts only you can.

01

### Outcomes, not output

We measure ourselves on hours saved and revenue earned, not lines of code or sprints completed.

02

### Ownership, not task completion

We treat your product as our own. We own the outcome, stay when things get hard, and don't cut
corners. Most clients stay 3+ years because of it.

03

### No fluff

No 80-page proposals, no 'discovery' that's really billing. We start with a working prototype in
week three.

Scispot’s API, JupyterHub, Python SDK, and CLI allow you to automate sample processing, analyze
multi-omics data, and integrate lab workflows—all through code. Effortlessly build, scale, and
deploy computational pipelines.

### Automate Sample Management

.No more lost samples or manual errors. Scispot automates sample logging, tracking, and
organization, ensuring every sample is labeled, recorded, and always audit-ready.

### Collaborate in one place

Ditch manual data entry and disconnected systems. Scispot links teams, instruments, and workflows in
one platform, reducing bottlenecks and improving efficiency across research, testing, and
production.

### Stay Audit-Ready with Automated Compliance

Never scramble for an audit again. Scispot automatically tracks every action, maintains regulatory
compliance, and scales effortlessly—whether you're a startup or a global lab.

## Frequently Asked Questions

#### How many languages does Smartcat support?

On Smartcat, you can translate content into 280+ languages. The full list of supported languages is
available [here][48].

#### What file formats can I translate on Smartcat?

Smartcat supports 50+ file formats including DOC, JPEG, PDF, JSON, XLIFF, and more. You can find the
full list in [this article][49].

#### Does Smartcat provide translation services?

Smartcat has an integrated Marketplace with 500,000+ translators, editors, proofreaders, and
agencies to fulfill any of your translation projects.
You can choose different translation options such as AI translation, human translation, or a
combination (automatic translation with professional editing).
Thanks to Smartcat’s payment automation system, you can hire as many translators as you need,
collaborate with them with one agreement, and pay them all with just one invoice every month.

#### Can I use Smartcat for translation project management?

Smartcat is the perfect solution to manage your translation projects and collaborate with teams
across your organization. It provides an advanced translation management system for localization
professionals with a simple intuitive interface that anyone in your company can use. You can also
automate supplier hiring and management using AI-driven linguist sourcing that’s integrated into the
Smartcat Marketplace.

#### Can I localize my website using Smartcat?

Yes. You can easily localize your website using [Smartcat Website Translator][50] which works with
any CMS and allows you to preview, edit and publish translations in real-time. Smartcat also
supports 30+ integrations with tools and platforms you already use so you can easily set up a
continuous localization process.

#### What are the benefits of Smartcat over other localization solutions?

While Smartcat is one of the most sophisticated localization solutions, it makes translation
accessible to anyone in your company through a simple, user-friendly UI. You don’t have to be a
localization expert to use Smartcat — just sign up and start translating your content into 280+
languages in minutes.
Smartcat’s AI Translation technology matches your content with a specific translation engine to
produce high-quality translations for all your language pairs. It also learns from your edits and
gets better with every translation, saving you both turnaround time and money.
With Smartcat’s unlimited seat model, you can invite as many colleagues as you like to collaborate
on your translation projects, or find professional translators and editors in the integrated
[Marketplace][51] of 500,000+ linguists. Any edits that you or your coworkers make will also be fed
into the algorithm to improve the quality and speed of your future translations.

#### Can I migrate my translation database to Smartcat from third-party translation software?

Smartcat supports all the popular translation memory formats, so you can easily transfer your
translation database to Smartcat and take advantage of all the work your team has already done. You
can also upload your materials to Smartcat to train the AI translation algorithm and start off with
a higher translation quality.

translation database to Smartcat and take advantage of all the work your team has already done. You
can also upload your materials to Smartcat to train the AI translation algorithm and start off with
a higher translation quality.

Methodology

## Evidence earns the badge, not a payment

Three tiers, one rule: nothing moves up a page or into a tier because someone paid for it.

Roster PickVerifiedListed
01Listed

### Listedthe floor

A real website offering AI implementation services, an identifiable human behind it, activity in the
last 12 months, and English-speaking clients. This alone excludes the label-slappers and anonymous
shells.

02Verified

### Verifiedthe brand promise

The floor plus at least two of five independent evidence signals. The bar stays evidence-based
without demanding paperwork from profiles nobody has claimed yet.

03Roster Pick

### Roster Pickeditorial, never sold

The hand-reviewed top few in each vertical, the ones we'd send our own clients to. Judged on
evidence and work quality, never on payment.

### Two of these five earn a Verified badge

[See the scoring][52]
* Vendor certificationsClaude, Zapier, Make, n8n partner programs. Real ones only.
* Named case studiesA real client or a concrete, checkable metric.
* Third-party reviewsFive or more on Clutch, G2, Google, or Upwork.
* Cross-listingsCorroborated across two or more independent directories.
* Public footprintOpen source, published workflows, talks, real audience.

## Own your workflow automation tool *end-to-end*

### Flexible deployment

Run ThinkAutomation on-premises or self-host on a cloud machine of your choice. Access and update
private data and reduce running costs.

### Connect to the cloud

Connect automated workflows to public web forms. Connect to and update cloud services. Provide a
secure gateway to on-premises data.

### Enhanced AI automation

Chat with your own data. Automate AI for classification, image analysis, data extraction and more.

## Top workflow automation use cases for ThinkAutomation

[workflow-icon]

### Email to database

Email automation can be configured to monitor specific email accounts or folders, identify key data
points (such as customer inquiries and order details), and automatically populate your database. For
example, if your sales team receives order confirmations via email, ThinkAutomation can extract the
order details and update your CRM or ERP system without manually entering the data.

[Learn more ][172]

[workflow-icon]

### Intelligent document processing (IDP)

Success shouldn’t be a one-off. When we train you teams user adoption surges and your Power Platform

What we do

## Two ways we bring your data to life

Most of our work ≈ 80%

### Custom BI & automation projects

We design dashboards, automate workflows and build business apps in the tools you already use: the
Microsoft Power Platform, SharePoint, Looker Studio, Tableau, GA4 and more.

Every project is built for how your business actually runs. No off-the-shelf templates dressed up as
a solution.

What makes us different ≈ 20%

### Our own BI connector software

We build and sell our own connectors that pull your data automatically from Shopify, QuickBooks
Online, ClickUp and many more sources.

No competitor offers this. Because we own the software, we already know the exact format of your
data – so we deliver projects faster, with fewer surprises.

just like:

During the execution process the work was very smooth. We had daily communications and we made it.
We created powerful Power BI reports that are used on daily basis by all the business units within
the company: sales, management, procurement, operations and of course finance. 

I can say that the Vidi team provided ingenious solutions to very complex problems and really helped
me and my team.

CFO

Neterra Telecommunications

I was really impressed with the skills that I have seen from the team. The biggest thing that I
noticed was the great communication from the team, everyone was very responsive despite time
differences.

Stewards Lawncare

The automation that we created saves us 2 admin staff per year!

One other important result from our automation project is that now we have consistency. Once we set
it up we no longer repeat mistakes. This was instrumental during a period of fast growth of our
company.

I give full marks to Vidi Corp for their skills in Power Apps, Power Automate and Power BI.

Gabriel Murrey

Managing Director

Lift Consultancy

## Our Consulting Services

Reduce development time. Cut costs. Empower your teams. And get your mission-critical data projects
over the line – fast.

Experts in Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio, Looker and DOMO. Ready to help you choose the right
business intelligence tool and develop tailored BI solutions!

### Consulting Services][160]

Our structured Google Analytics consulting services provide comprehensive support from initial setup

## BI Data Connectors Benefits

Our BI connectors enable automatic data connectivity to Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio or SQL
Server.

#### We know your data

We built these connectors and use them across hundreds of projects, so we understand your data
sources deeply. Projects start faster.

#### Faster support

No third party sits between you and a fix. We own the code, so we resolve support tickets faster and
keep your data flowing.

#### Reusable solutions

Years of projects mean we have ready-made solutions to reuse. You get more, sooner, without paying
to build from scratch.

#### Free templates

Connect your data with our software and get free Power BI templates and dashboards built to match
your source.

### Common Questions About Workflow Automation

##### What is workflow automation?

Workflow automation uses software to handle routine business tasks such as data entry, approvals,
form routing, and notifications without manual effort. It connects systems like Cognito Forms,
HubSpot, QuickBooks Online, and DocuSign so work moves automatically from one step to the next. See
all workflow automation FAQs.

##### How long does it take to build an automation system?

Small automation projects can launch within days. Mid-sized multi-system integrations typically take
2 to 4 weeks. Larger builds involving CRM customization, accounting integration, and document
automation may require 4 to 8 weeks. Scope and deliverables are defined clearly before development
begins.

##### Do you offer ongoing managed support?

Yes. Ongoing managed automation support includes monitoring workflows, troubleshooting connectors,
maintaining websites, and implementing enhancements on a monthly basis. Most clients start with a
one-time build and move to managed support once the system is running.

### Common Questions About Workflow Automation

##### What is workflow automation?

Workflow automation uses software to handle routine business tasks such as data entry, approvals,
form routing, and notifications without manual effort. It connects systems like Cognito Forms,
HubSpot, QuickBooks Online, and DocuSign so work moves automatically from one step to the next. See
all workflow automation FAQs.

##### How long does it take to build an automation system?

Small automation projects can launch within days. Mid-sized multi-system integrations typically take
2 to 4 weeks. Larger builds involving CRM customization, accounting integration, and document
automation may require 4 to 8 weeks. Scope and deliverables are defined clearly before development
begins.

##### Do you offer ongoing managed support?

Yes. Ongoing managed automation support includes monitoring workflows, troubleshooting connectors,
maintaining websites, and implementing enhancements on a monthly basis. Most clients start with a
one-time build and move to managed support once the system is running.
